WITH vendor_vri AS (
    SELECT 
        vendortrace,
        CASE 
            WHEN vendsecrate = 'A' THEN 4
            WHEN vendsecrate = 'B' THEN 3
            WHEN vendsecrate = 'C' THEN 2
            ELSE 1
        END * CASE WHEN contrstate = 'Active' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.5 END AS vri
    FROM vendormanagement
),
vendor_risk_tier AS (
    SELECT 
        vendortrace,
        vri,
        CASE 
            WHEN vri < 2 THEN 'High Risk'
            WHEN vri >= 2 AND vri < 3 THEN 'Medium Risk'
            ELSE 'Low Risk'
        END AS risk_level
    FROM vendor_vri
)
SELECT 
    risk_level,
    COUNT(*) AS entity_count,
    ROUND(COUNT(*)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(*))::numeric OVER (), 4) AS proportion
FROM vendor_risk_tier
GROUP BY risk_level
ORDER BY risk_level;
